case.complaintText: Dobrý deň, sklenená váza, ktorú som si objednala, prišla rozbitá. Posielam fotky.

attachments.extractedNotes: Vase visibly shattered, image shows broken glass inside partial packaging.

generatedCustomerRequest.text: Ďakujeme za nahlásenie a fotografiu poškodenej vázy. Aby sme mohli prípad rýchlo vybaviť, prosíme vás ešte o fotografiu vonkajšieho obalu (kartónovej škatule), v akom balík dorazil. Stačí jedna fotografia, ktorá ukazuje stav krabice.

resolutionProposal.rationale: Fragile-goods category with confirmed damage photo; policy allows immediate replacement pending stock once evidence is complete (Complaint Guide 3.2). Outer-packaging photo still missing.

policySource.excerpt: 3.2 For fragile-goods categories (glass, ceramics), a confirmed shipping-damage complaint with complete evidence is eligible for immediate replacement, pending stock availability, without waiting for the carrier claim outcome.

customerReplyDraft.text: Je nám ľúto, že váza dorazila poškodená. Po doručení fotografie vonkajšieho obalu vám obratom pošleme náhradný kus.
customerReplyDraft.internalSummaryEn: Fragile-goods damage claim, product photo received, outer-packaging photo requested. Replacement recommended once evidence is complete.

recoveryDraft.damageSummary: Glass vase (SKU VASE-GLASS-30CM) received shattered. Outer-packaging photo pending from customer before claim submission.
recoveryDraft.nextAction: Await outer-packaging photo, then submit claim within NordicShip's 14-day window (delivered 2026-09-08).
